review: Used to spend a ton of hours into this game and found it to be incredible, however when it was moved away from the orginal dev team, the game went into an absolutely shitty P2W model and the game was forever ruined with money milking, crates, and nothing to be added.

It's a great game if you can get over 2011 graphics, has a unique  leveling system with the addition of a tradeskill system, obtaining resources can be challenging in lower level areas but you will almost always find the essentials, combat is enjoyable in both third person and first. The multitude of towns and areas to do quests in means there is always content. However the only downside is that some quests require or are easier to do with multiple people

This is a pretty good game, especially since its free to play. I think most of the negative reviews are pretty unfair and are coming from people who miss the original development team (from what i've read) but as a newcomer the game has tons to offer. It isn't that hard to get the hang of even though the controls are a little unusual and take a bit of getting used to when you start (even after adjusting them more to your own liking). My number 1 complaint is that you cant go into water at all, and if you try to hop over it and miss you'll get stuck and have to suicide to the nearest clone-pod-thing. 

There is an abundance of crafting materials and things to craft, lots of skills and a nice leveling/expirience system, and enemies and crafting materials respawn frequently making it easy to farm and level in populated areas.  So far it seems only the begining/main story line had voice acting, so theres a lot of reading but that isn't really a big deal. Running around the world  you'll see tons of other quests you can pick up along the way which so far for me have been easy to understand and complete. 

This game isn't life-changing or anything, but I can definately see myself sinking a good chunk of time into it, and from what i've read/seen the map is pretty huge. If you're debating playing because of the negative reviews you should ignore them and download anyways. I mean why not, its free.

I tried this game years ago and had issues with it not running smoothly no matter what I did, I have a new computer now and decided to try again and guess what. Even though my system exceeds the required specs by leeps and bounds it doesn't matter what I do I can't make the game run in a way that's playable. Frames per second are so low at any settings (changing settings doesn't seem to have any effect on anything) that if I press the arrow key it may or may not decide to turn my character after about 5 minutes and if it does it may turn me 1 degree or 180 degrees for the same duration press of the arrow key, using the mouse is not much better. I don't know how the game still has any players hell I don't know how this game ever got shown to the public let alone through alpha/beta testing. Plain and simple it's a waste of time to download it so give it a pass.
